title: Optimize for Chat and Agents in One Platform
summary: Gauge brings AEO and coding agent optimization together. Use Gauge Chat and Gauge Agents through one CLI and MCP.
body_markdown:
Gauge is the first platform to offer a single interface to optimize for chat surfaces like ChatGPT or Claude, and coding agents like Claude Code. With a unified[CLI](https://docs.withgauge.com/cli) and[MCP](https://docs.withgauge.com/gauge-mcp) , you can now query data and run workflows across Gauge Chat and Gauge Agents in one place.


## Why bring them together?


Agent-led growth comes from a combined effort across AI surfaces, including the traditional chat interfaces like ChatGPT, and agentic interfaces like Claude Code or Codex.


When you write new content, Gauge helps you measure the full impact. Bringing the data together means you can confidently write content that reaches ChatGPT sessions and Codex sessions alike.


Having the data in one place also makes it easier to spot gaps in coverage. Coding agents often read docs and technical posts that might not show up often in chat.


If you want to optimize for the AI surfaces your buyers are using, you want measurement across the whole spectrum. With Gauge, you (or your agent) can optimize all your AI-facing content in one place.


## Get started


Get started with your existing Gauge account and the[CLI](https://docs.withgauge.com/cli) and[MCP](https://docs.withgauge.com/gauge-mcp) documentation.


This post is part of[Gauge Launch Week](https://www.withgauge.com/blog/gauge-launch-week) .
